title: Clean-boot reset + reliable post-login dashboard redirect with non-blank protected loading states

requirements.summary: Implement a full clean-boot reset that clears all storefront auth, cart, wishlist, and related persisted client state and returns the app to a first-run state.
acceptanceCriteria: After invoking the reset flow, the following are cleared from browser storage: OTP session, flash message, return path, OTP lockout state/attempts, cart, and wishlist.
After invoking the reset flow, the user is logged out of Internet Identity in the app context (if previously logged in).
After invoking the reset flow, navigating to /dashboard redirects to /login and does not show a blank screen.

file_operations.description: Create a centralized full clean-boot reset utility that clears storefront-related localStorage/sessionStorage keys (OTP session, flash message, return path, OTP lockout/attempts, cart, wishlist, and other storefront-auth-related persisted keys such as local profile fallback), and supports clearing in-memory caches via injected callbacks (e.g., React Query clear, Internet Identity clear).

Add a small exported helper (or returned function) that enumerates/clears all storefront-auth storage keys used by this hook (OTP session, flash message, return path, lockout, attempts) so the full clean-boot reset can reliably wipe them without missing any keys.

Ensure the cart persistence key is clearly defined/centralized (and optionally exported) so the full clean-boot reset can reliably wipe the cart state and storage without relying on hardcoded strings.

Ensure the wishlist persistence key is clearly defined/centralized (and optionally exported) so the full clean-boot reset can reliably wipe wishlist state and storage without relying on hardcoded strings.
Update dashboard logout handling to call the shared full clean-boot reset utility (including Internet Identity clear + React Query cache clear) so logout and emergency reset behave consistently.

requirements.summary: Add an emergency URL-only reset entry point that works even when auth/routing is broken and ends on the Sign In view.
acceptanceCriteria: There is a documented, testable way to trigger the reset using only the browser URL (no prior navigation required).
After triggering the reset entry point, the app ends on /login?tab=signin (or equivalent Sign In state) and renders normally.

file_operations.description: Create a minimal emergency reset view that runs the full clean-boot reset on mount and then navigates to /login?tab=signin; render a visible progress/loading UI while executing. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Button/Alert) to ensure consistent UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire a dedicated /reset route into the custom SPA routing flow so it can be triggered directly via browser URL; ensure it renders ResetPage without relying on prior navigation state.
Add a URL-triggered fallback reset mechanism (e.g., /login?reset=1) that runs the full clean-boot reset before showing the login UI, then ensures the final URL/state is /login?tab=signin.
Document the emergency reset entry points (e.g., /reset and /login?reset=1) and the expected post-reset landing behavior for manual verification.

requirements.summary: Make OTP and Internet Identity login redirect consistently to /dashboard (or a safe stored return path), clearing the return path after navigation and preventing blank-screen first load issues.
acceptanceCriteria: After successful OTP verification, the app navigates to /dashboard when no return path is set.
After successful Internet Identity login, the app navigates to /dashboard when no return path is set.
If a return path exists, it is used instead of /dashboard, and the return path is cleared after navigation.
A hard refresh immediately after login does not produce a blank screen and the user remains on a valid route.

file_operations.description: Create a small utility to validate and normalize a stored return path (must be an internal path, disallow /login, /reset, /admin*, and any non-path values) and provide a safe fallback (default /dashboard).

Update return-path capture to store the full in-app path (pathname + search when appropriate) and to avoid storing unsafe routes; ensure redirect behavior is deterministic under first-load conditions.

Change post-success navigation for both OTP verification and Internet Identity login to go to a safe stored return path if present, otherwise /dashboard; ensure return path is cleared after successful navigation.

requirements.summary: Prevent /dashboard first-load crashes by adding safe protected loading/error UI during auth restoration and while dashboard dependencies are not ready.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /dashboard never results in a permanently blank screen; if data is loading, a visible loading state is rendered.
If an error occurs while loading dashboard data, a visible error state is rendered with a recovery action (e.g., go to login, retry, or run reset).
ProtectedRoute does not leave the UI in a silent null-render state without any visible feedback during auth restoration.

file_operations.description: Replace the current null-render behavior with a visible fallback UI while auth is restoring and during redirect; ensure the component renders a non-blank loading state instead of returning null. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Alert/Button) for the fallback UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden dashboard rendering to handle loading and error states from profile/orders queries and other dependencies; add an explicit error screen area with recovery actions (retry, go to login, run reset) to ensure no blank screen even if a query fails.

Ensure dashboard-related queries expose stable loading/error behavior without throwing unhandled exceptions that could break initial dashboard render; keep query functions resilient and let UI render an explicit error state when failures occur.
Ensure /dashboard route wiring remains stable on first load and hard refresh by keeping providers consistent and enabling the updated ProtectedRoute fallback UI to be visible during auth restoration.

requirements.summary: Clear in-memory caches (including React Query) during reset and force clean navigation to login so the app works without manual refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: After reset, React Query cache is cleared and subsequent page loads re-fetch data normally.
After reset, the login page works without requiring an additional manual refresh.

file_operations.description: Extend the full clean-boot reset utility to accept and invoke React Query cache clearing (via QueryClient.clear), clear any relevant in-memory state via provided callbacks (e.g., cart/wishlist clears), and perform a forced clean navigation to /login?tab=signin.

Wire ResetPage to clear React Query cache (useQueryClient), clear Internet Identity (useInternetIdentity().clear), clear commerce/wishlist in-memory state, then navigate to /login?tab=signin after the reset completes; keep a visible loading/progress UI during execution. Use shadcn-ui components for UI consistency. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Update the dashboard's logout/reset recovery actions to call the shared reset utility so React Query is cleared and navigation to /login?tab=signin is clean and immediate (no extra refresh needed).
